caption: Aerial photograph of bypass
history:
From the air
This 1961 picture appeared in the Leicester Evening Mail, its caption read: ‘Dominating this view is the new dual carriageway by-pass which cuts out the bottleneck formed by the narrow main road of the village. Near the top of the picture can be seen the footbridge which caused much criticism when it was built.’
This criticism related to the siting of the footbridge because not all residents agreed with its position.
